TOOL_RESULT get_schema:
{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,
    region_code TEXT, signup_date TEXT, tier TEXT)
CREATE TABLE order_items (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER,
    quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_ts TEXT,
    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, method TEXT,
    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT, product_name TEXT,
    category TEXT, list_price_twd INTEGER, is_active INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE refunds (refund_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, item_id INTEGER,
    refund_amount_twd INTEGER, refund_ts TEXT, reason_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE shipments (shipment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, carrier TEXT,
    shipped_ts TEXT, delivered_ts TEXT)"}

{"thought": "語意層沒有「註冊日期」的定義，但 customers.signup_date 看起來就是註冊日期。先抽樣確認日期格式，並同時計算 2025 年 3 月的客戶數。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT signup_date, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY length(signup_date), substr(signup_date,1,4) ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20", "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS march_2025_customers FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2025-03%'"]}}

[{"query": "SELECT signup_date, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY length(signup_date), substr(signup_date,1,4) ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20", "columns": ["signup_date", "n"], "rows": [["2024-06-27", 1708], ["2023-06-30", 1659], ["2025-10-04", 1633]], "truncated": false}, {"query": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS march_2025_customers FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2025-03%'", "columns": ["march_2025_customers"], "rows": [[150]], "truncated": false}]

{"thought": "前一個查詢的分組結果不可靠（只顯示任意代表值），且 LIKE '2025-03%' 只涵蓋 ISO 格式。先檢查 signup_date 的格式分布，確認是否有其他寫法會漏算。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT length(signup_date) AS len, substr(signup_date,1,4) AS yr_prefix, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(signup_date) AS min_val, MAX(signup_date) AS max_val FROM customers GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY n DESC", "SELECT customer_id, signup_date FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '%2025%03%' OR signup_date LIKE '%03/2025%' OR signup_date LIKE '%2025/3%' OR signup_date LIKE '2025-3%' OR signup_date LIKE '2025-03%' LIMIT 50"]}}

{"thought": "目前的 LIKE 計數只依賴 ISO 格式，且第二次的列表混入了 2025-09、2025-11 等非三月日期。改用日期區間條件重新計算，並檢查三月的日期範圍是否正確。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS march_2025_signups, MIN(signup_date) AS min_date, MAX(signup_date) AS max_date FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND signup_date < '2025-04-01'", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date IS NULL OR signup_date = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_or_empty_signup FROM customers"]}}

response: {"thought": "三月區間查詢得到 150 筆，customer_id 為主鍵故無重複，signup_date 全為 10 碼 ISO 格式且無空值，可直接交付。", "tool": "submit_answer", "args": {"answer": "150", "basis": "語意層未收錄「新註冊客戶」與「註冊日期」，改以 customers.signup_date 作為註冊日期。以 signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND < '2025-04-01' 計算，結果 150 位（customer_id 為主鍵，無重複）；已確認所有日期皆為 10 碼 ISO 格式且無空值。"}}
